zh.q: 模型已经很聪明，为什么还需要企业知识库？
zh.a:
一个熟悉行业常识的模型，不一定知道你公司的最新制度、产品参数和客户约定。员工问“这份合同谁能审批”，需要的不是一段通用的合同管理建议，而是适用于当前部门、金额和地区的具体流程。模型没有这些资料，就无法凭空知道答案。

把资料上传到聊天窗口，可以解决一次性问答，却没有自动解决知识更新、版本冲突、权限控制和责任追踪。随着文件与使用人数增加，这些问题会逐渐进入日常工作。企业知识库真正需要建设的是从资料到可信答案的完整路径：信息从哪里来，谁可以看到，什么时候更新，以及答错时怎样发现。

zh.q: 把所有文档放进上下文，为什么不够？
zh.a:
资料越多，不代表每次回答越准确。一个问题可能只需要制度中的几段，但把所有历史文件都送入模型，会增加处理成本，也让旧版本、例外条款和无关内容争夺注意力。长对话还会累积不再适用的信息，造成答案前后不一致。

我们通常先把资料整理成可检索的知识，再根据问题、用户身份与任务阶段选择相关内容。检索并不只是找到关键词，而是把文档结构、适用范围、生效状态和权限一起考虑。对于无法确定版本的资料，系统应该明确返回缺口，交给知识负责人处理，而不是让模型自行选择一个看起来合理的答案。

zh.q: RAG 是接入一个搜索框吗？
zh.a:
检索增强生成的核心，是先找到依据，再基于依据回答。但生产系统中，检索之前就有大量工作：扫描文件是否能正确识别，表格的行列关系是否保留，同一制度的不同版本如何区分，文档拆分后能不能保留必要上下文。

检索结果也需要检查。找到的段落可能只回答问题的一部分，或者包含互相冲突的规则。一个可靠的工作流会检查来源与覆盖范围，必要时继续检索、向用户补充提问，或拒绝给出未经支持的结论。对用户而言，这些步骤不需要成为复杂操作；它们应该体现在更清楚的回答和能打开核对的引用里。

zh.q: 引用链接为什么不能只是一个装饰？
zh.a:
答案下面列出文件名，只能说明系统看过文件，不能证明某句话得到了支持。业务人员需要能从回答中的关键判断，追溯到对应条款、章节和有效版本。如果引用的是整份几十页的制度，核查成本仍然落在用户身上。

因此，引用要与回答的具体内容关联。对于政策、费用和权限类问题，系统应当保留实际使用的依据和处理过程，方便复核与排查。对无法被资料支持的内容，需要直接表达不确定性。我们更愿意让系统把问题交还给负责人，也不把语言流畅当成事实正确的证明。

zh.q: 一个知识库，如何服务不同权限的员工？
zh.a:
权限应该在检索前生效，而不是先把所有资料交给模型，再要求它不要泄露。系统需要知道访问者的身份、所属组织与角色，让其只能检索到已授权的资料。跨部门共享的内容，也应当明确共享范围和生效时间。

同样，日志的可见范围也需要设计。管理员排查问题时，不应因为查看调试记录而获得不必要的敏感信息。权限变更、账号离职、文档撤回都要进入知识更新流程。私有化部署能够满足一部分数据边界要求，但它并不能替代应用层的访问控制、审计和敏感信息处理。

zh.q: 什么问题应该交给 AI，什么问题需要人工？
zh.a:
适合自动回答的，通常是资料明确、重复频繁、风险可控的问题，例如设备申请流程、常规账号操作与已知故障处理。涉及身份异常、权限提升、个体争议或资料冲突的请求，则应交给有权限的人判断。

转人工不应该意味着用户重说一遍问题。系统可以保留已经确认的事实、查到的资料和尝试过的步骤，形成一个清楚的工单。这样人工接手时能从已有进度继续，而不是重新开始。验收时也要检查这条路径：不仅看系统会回答多少，还要看它是否知道什么时候停止，以及交接的信息是否足够完整。

zh.q: 怎样判断第一版真的有用？
zh.a:
先选一组来自真实业务的历史问题，整理可接受答案和对应依据，再评估回答正确性、引用有效性、权限隔离和转人工质量。对于没有答案、问题模糊或资料过期的情况，也要单独测试。只测试容易回答的问题，会掩盖上线后最常见的风险。

在我们交付的 IT 知识库助手项目中，常见工单自动拦截比例达到 80%，平均响应时间低于 3 秒。这些结果来自具体项目，不能直接当作其他企业的保证。新项目需要根据资料质量、问题分布与业务要求定义自己的验收标准，再通过小范围使用验证价值。

zh.q: 企业应该从哪里开始？
zh.a:
不必先整理整个公司的所有文档。可以从一个明确的团队、一个稳定的知识范围和一批重复问题开始。确定谁负责更新知识，谁审核高风险答案，以及问题无法解决时由谁接手。业务负责人、知识维护者和技术团队共同参与，比单独购买一个聊天界面更重要。

业务诊断阶段，我们会检查资料、权限与现有流程，判断是可以直接启动试点，还是先解决知识质量问题。第一版的目标不是让 AI 回答一切，而是让一个有价值的工作范围变得可靠、可用、可以持续改进。

en.q: If models are so capable, why build a company knowledge base?
en.a:
Knowing an industry is different from knowing your company’s latest policies, product specifications and client commitments. An employee asking who can approve a contract needs the process that applies to their department and transaction, not general advice on contract management.

Uploading files into a chat can help with a one-off question. It does not automatically resolve updates, conflicting versions, permissions or accountability. A company knowledge system needs a complete path from source to answer: where information came from, who can access it, when it changed and how an incorrect answer will be caught.

en.q: Why not put every document into the context window?
en.a:
More material does not always improve an answer. A question may need only a few paragraphs. Sending the full archive increases processing costs and places old policies, exceptions and irrelevant content alongside the right evidence.

We organize sources for retrieval and select context based on the question, user permissions and task. Document structure, scope and effective version matter alongside keywords. When the current policy cannot be established, the system should expose that gap and involve its owner rather than guess.

en.q: Is RAG just a search box connected to a model?
en.a:
Retrieval-augmented generation finds supporting material before generating an answer. In production, substantial work happens before retrieval: reading scans, preserving table relationships, separating versions and splitting documents without losing their meaning.

Retrieved passages also need evaluation. They may answer only part of the question or contain conflicting rules. A useful workflow checks coverage and provenance, retrieves more when necessary, asks for clarification or declines to draw an unsupported conclusion. The user experiences a clearer answer with evidence they can inspect.

en.q: What makes a citation useful?
en.a:
A file name under an answer shows that a document was consulted. It does not prove that the document supports a particular claim. Users need to trace material statements to the relevant passage and effective version. A link to an entire policy manual leaves too much checking to the reader.

We connect citations to specific assertions and preserve the evidence used for policy, expense and access questions. Unsupported conclusions should remain explicitly uncertain. Fluent wording is not a substitute for a verifiable source.

en.q: How do you serve employees with different permissions?
en.a:
Permissions should apply before retrieval. Giving a model every document and asking it not to reveal sensitive information is not an adequate access boundary. The system should identify the user, role and organization, then retrieve only authorized material.

Logs need their own access controls. Account changes, departures and document withdrawals must update the knowledge system. Private deployment may address infrastructure boundaries, but it does not replace application-level permissions, auditability or sensitive-data handling.

en.q: Where does the human handoff belong?
en.a:
Clear, frequent and low-risk questions are good candidates for automation: equipment requests, routine account procedures and documented troubleshooting. Identity exceptions, elevated privileges, individual disputes and conflicting policies need an authorized person.

A handoff should preserve the facts established, sources found and steps already tried. The user should not have to start again. Acceptance testing must check whether the system recognizes its limits and whether the receiving team gets enough context to act.

en.q: How do you know a first version is useful?
en.a:
Start with actual historical questions and agreed answers. Evaluate factual accuracy, useful citations, permission boundaries and handoff quality. Include ambiguous questions, missing information and outdated sources, not just easy examples.

In our IT knowledge assistant project, AI handled 80% of routine tickets with an average response time below three seconds. Those are results from a specific project, not a promise for every organization. Each implementation needs acceptance criteria tied to its own source quality, workload and risks.

en.q: Where should a company begin?
en.a:
Choose one team, a stable body of knowledge and a recurring set of questions. Name the person who maintains the sources, the reviewer for sensitive answers and the owner of unresolved requests.

During diagnosis, we examine documents, permissions and the existing workflow. Sometimes a pilot can begin immediately; sometimes source quality needs attention first. The objective is a valuable, reliable working scope that can improve over time.

zh.q: 15 分钟到底交付了什么？
zh.a:
交付的是可以继续编辑和复核的方案初稿，不是未经审核就能提交的最终文件。初稿把项目要求、已有资料、引用依据与待复核的假设组织到一起，让撰写者从审阅和打磨开始，而不是面对空白文档。

在专业咨询与投研机构的项目中，过去需要约两天完成的资料整理与初稿撰写，被整合为一条智能工作流。系统可以在 15 分钟内生成初稿，引用准确率达到 99%，并执行 7 项完整性检查。数字描述的是这个项目的结果；新场景的速度与质量，要根据资料和验收要求重新评估。

zh.q: 第一步是选模型，还是整理历史资料？
zh.a:
先弄清楚一份合格方案由什么组成。不同企业对章节、论证、报价、参数和引用的要求可能很不一样。即使两份文档名称相同，实际审批标准也可能不同。如果不先理解这些标准，生成速度再快，也可能只是在更快地产生返工。

我们会与业务团队一起梳理输入、模板、历史版本和审核意见，区分可复用知识与特定项目内容。技术参数、客户约束和关键假设应有明确来源。历史方案可以提供结构与经验，但不应把旧项目的事实直接带进新方案。

zh.q: 历史标书如何变成可以复用的知识？
zh.a:
文档入库要保留章节、表格、附件之间的关系。技术参数不能脱离对应设备或版本，条款也不能只剩一段文字而失去适用条件。系统需要记录资料来源、更新时间和使用范围，使后续检索有足够依据。

我们把稳定的产品知识、历史论证材料与当前项目输入分开管理。生成时先确认当前项目的目标与限制，再检索相关内容。对于资料缺失的部分，系统保留明确的问题清单，让业务人员补充。空缺不应该被模型凭经验填成一个看似合理的数字。

zh.q: 为什么不能一次性让 AI 写完整份方案？
zh.a:
复杂方案通常包含多个相互依赖的判断。需求理解有偏差，后面的技术路线、成本和实施计划都可能跟着偏离。一次生成所有章节，会让问题藏在长篇文本中，增加复核难度。

工作流把任务拆为可检查的步骤：确认客户诉求、提取约束、检索依据、构建提纲、生成章节、检查完整性、整理风险。关键节点保留人工确认。对不同章节，可以采用不同的检索范围与校验规则，让业务负责人知道系统正在依据什么做出判断。

zh.q: 参数回填和完整性检查怎么做？
zh.a:
参数回填的前提是字段定义清楚：单位是什么，值来自哪里，适用于哪个版本，是否允许为空。对需要计算的字段，最好通过确定的计算逻辑处理，而不是依靠模型在自然语言中猜算。生成内容也应当保留参数来源，便于复核。

完整性检查则根据项目约定的审核清单执行。系统检查关键章节、必填信息与必要论证是否出现，并把缺项与风险显式呈现。在现有项目里，界面展示了 7 项检查；其他企业不应直接复制数量，而应根据自己的交付标准制定清单。

zh.q: 哪些判断必须由人来做？
zh.a:
最终承诺、商业条款、敏感假设和专业责任需要由有权限的人确认。AI 可以协助整理证据、提出风险与形成草稿，但不能代替签署方做业务承诺。审核入口应当直接连接到引用和关键假设，让负责人可以核查，而不是逐页盲读。

我们也会明确失败时的处理方式。资料不足、来源冲突、必填参数缺失，都应该触发暂停或补充信息流程。系统的价值在于缩短重复劳动，同时让重要判断更清楚；如果只是把错误埋进一份排版精美的文件，就没有完成工程交付。

zh.q: 上线前，怎样测试质量？
zh.a:
选取具有代表性的真实项目，既包括常规情况，也包括资料缺失、条款冲突和约束复杂的情况。把人工认可的输出作为参照，逐项核查内容覆盖、参数一致、引用正确与风险提示。不要只凭一份展示效果很好的文档决定上线。

还要记录人工修改发生在哪里。如果修改主要集中在少数固定章节，就可以回到检索或模板设计中解决；如果业务判断每次都不同，则应保留更明确的人工输入。可追踪的修改记录，能够帮助系统持续改进，也能让团队判断自动化到底节省了什么。

zh.q: 怎样从一个场景扩展到更多文档？
zh.a:
先稳定一个重复率高、资料较齐全、验收标准明确的文档类型。确认业务人员愿意使用，并且审核时间确实缩短，再扩展到相邻类型。每增加一种文档，都要确认输入、结构、校验与责任人，不能只复制一个提示词。

长期来看，可复用的资产是知识索引、数据连接、工作流、审核规则与使用反馈。模型可以更换，业务标准也会变化，但这些资产能让系统持续贴合真实工作。一次业务诊断，通常就能看出应该先从哪个文档场景开始。

en.q: What is delivered in 15 minutes?
en.a:
An editable draft ready for review, not a final document ready to submit without approval. It assembles project requirements, source material, citations and assumptions so the writer can begin by reviewing and improving the argument.

For a consulting and research firm, a process that previously took roughly two days became a workflow producing a first draft in 15 minutes, with 99% citation accuracy and seven completeness checks. These are results from that implementation. New use cases need their own evaluation.

en.q: Do you start with the model or the source material?
en.a:
We start by understanding what makes an acceptable proposal. Requirements for structure, reasoning, pricing, specifications and citations differ by company. Faster generation is not valuable if it simply creates more rework.

Together with the business team, we examine inputs, templates, prior versions and reviewer comments. We separate reusable knowledge from project-specific facts. Previous proposals are useful references; they are not permission to carry old assumptions into a new commitment.

en.q: How do past proposals become reusable knowledge?
en.a:
Ingestion preserves relationships between sections, tables and attachments. A parameter needs its equipment version and units; a clause needs its scope. Sources, update dates and use boundaries remain attached to the material.

Stable product knowledge, previous reasoning and current project inputs are managed separately. The workflow confirms the new project’s constraints before retrieving relevant evidence. Missing information becomes a clear question for the team, not an invented figure.

en.q: Why not generate the whole proposal in one request?
en.a:
Complex proposals contain dependent decisions. Misunderstanding the requirement can distort the technical approach, cost and delivery plan. Generating everything at once makes those errors harder to isolate.

We break the work into inspectable steps: confirm the need, extract constraints, retrieve evidence, build an outline, draft sections, check completeness and expose risks. Important checkpoints remain with people. Each section can use its own sources and validation rules.

en.q: How do parameter filling and completeness checks work?
en.a:
Each field needs a definition, unit, source, version and rule for missing values. Calculations are better handled through deterministic logic than by asking a model to guess inside prose. The draft retains parameter provenance.

Completeness checks follow the agreed review checklist. They identify missing sections, inputs and supporting arguments. The existing project uses seven checks; another organization should design its checklist around its own standards, not copy the count.

en.q: What still requires human judgment?
en.a:
Final commitments, commercial terms, sensitive assumptions and professional responsibility remain with authorized reviewers. AI can organize evidence and surface risks; it does not sign off on a business obligation.

Missing sources, conflicting references and absent parameters should pause the workflow or request clarification. The aim is to reduce repetitive work while making important decisions easier to inspect, not to hide errors inside a polished document.

en.q: How is quality tested before launch?
en.a:
Use representative real projects, including missing information and conflicting constraints. Compare against accepted work and inspect coverage, parameter consistency, citations and risk flags. One impressive sample is not a sufficient acceptance test.

Track where people make changes. Repeated corrections in the same section may point to a retrieval or template issue. Decisions that genuinely vary from project to project may require better human input. Those records guide useful iteration.

en.q: How do you expand to more document types?
en.a:
Stabilize one frequent, well-documented format with clear acceptance criteria. Confirm that people use it and review effort falls before expanding. Every new document type needs its own inputs, structure, checks and accountable owner.

The durable assets are the knowledge index, integrations, workflow, review rules and feedback—not a single prompt. A diagnosis helps identify the best starting point.

zh.q: 为什么不直接给所有客户做一套软件？
zh.a:
因为企业购买的东西并不总是软件。有的团队希望拥有一个长期使用、持续积累能力的工具；有的希望验证一个尚不确定的场景；还有的只需要稳定完成一批工作，不希望自己承担系统运营。把这些需求放进同一种合同和交付模式，往往会让双方都失望。

我们先讨论业务目标、现有流程、数据条件和使用频率，再决定合作方式。技术复杂度影响实施成本，但不应该代替商业判断。一个技术上可以实现的项目，也可能因为使用频率太低、资料准备成本太高，暂时不值得做。

zh.q: 什么情况下适合完整定制开发？
zh.a:
目标清楚、使用频率高、愿意指定业务负责人的团队，通常更适合把能力建设成自有系统。你需要的不只是一次结果，而是让员工长期通过同一个入口完成工作，并把数据、规则和使用反馈留在自己的流程里。

完整定制通常覆盖需求梳理、产品设计、模型接入、工作流开发、上线与基础维护。典型首期周期为 6–12 周，具体以范围为准。项目开始前需要明确验收标准、数据接入条件、系统边界与后续维护安排。拥有系统，也意味着需要有一个团队负责业务规则与使用推广。

zh.q: 低启动试点应该验证什么？
zh.a:
试点应该回答一个具体的商业问题：这段流程是否值得自动化，是否能在真实资料上稳定运行，业务人员是否愿意把它纳入日常工作。它不应该只是把一个演示界面做得更完整，也不应该把完整项目的全部范围压进一个小预算。

我们会选择边界清楚的场景，在 2–6 周交付首个可用版本。试点开始前，双方确定输入范围、关键指标和停止条件。看到结果后，再决定扩展、调整或结束。试点的意义在于用有限投入获得可靠判断，而不是预设结论一定是继续建设。

zh.q: 托管式 AI 服务适合哪些团队？
zh.a:
当企业更关心稳定产出，而不想招聘技术人员、维护工作流或持续跟进模型变化时，托管往往更合适。客户提供任务、资料与质量标准，Cyano 通过 AI 工作流和人工审核持续交付结果。

典型场景包括成批文档、内容整理或有固定审核标准的重复任务。首批结果通常在两周内交付，后续按月或按批次合作。这里最重要的是把结果说清楚：一批包括多少工作，如何验收，修改如何处理，什么情况下需要客户补充信息，以及超出范围的任务怎样报价。

zh.q: 怎样比较投入与回报？
zh.a:
先看当前流程的完整成本，而不只是某个人写一份文件用了多久。资料收集、沟通、审核、返工和等待都可能占用大量时间。还要分清节省的时间能否真正用于其他工作，以及更快的交付是否带来实际业务价值。

另一边是建设和持续使用的成本：数据整理、系统接入、模型调用、审核和维护，都应纳入评估。对无法准确量化的收益，可以先作为假设，在试点中验证。我们不会把一个客户的最高回报数字当作所有项目的结论，而是根据你自己的流程形成决策依据。

zh.q: 开始前需要准备哪些资料？
zh.a:
不需要先写一份完整的技术需求书。准备一个真实工作样本、当前的操作过程、常见问题和可接受的交付结果，通常就能开始讨论。如果有历史成本、处理量和审核反馈，也会帮助更快判断价值。

同时要找到真正拥有业务决定权的人，以及能解释数据与权限的人。很多项目的难点不在模型能力，而在谁能确认规则、谁负责提供资料、谁决定结果合格。诊断阶段把这些关系梳理清楚，后续设计和交付就会顺畅得多。

zh.q: 三种模式上线后，谁负责维护？
zh.a:
三种合作方式都需要明确上线后的责任。完整定制包含基础维护，并可以持续签约迭代；试点与持续服务的维护纳入服务范围；托管式服务由 Cyano 负责工作流运行与交付。客户仍需提供业务规则变化与必要反馈。

维护不只是修复故障。资料更新、权限调整、模型变化和新业务要求都可能影响输出。项目应建立反馈入口和变更判断方式，避免任何小修改都变成临时争论。稳定合作依赖明确的责任与可观察的结果，而不只是最初的一份功能清单。

zh.q: 如果试点效果不理想，应该怎么办？
zh.a:
先区分原因：业务问题是否选对，资料是否足够，流程是否设计合理，或者预期本身超出了可行范围。对每种原因，处理方式都不同。缺少资料需要补充知识，流程不顺需要调整产品，商业价值不足则可能应该停止。

所以，最好的开始不是承诺做出所有功能，而是共同定义验收标准与决策节点。一次 30–45 分钟的业务沟通可以帮助我们了解场景；一周内的诊断会给出建设建议。你看清楚范围、投入和不确定性之后，再决定是否推进。

en.q: Why not build the same kind of software engagement for everyone?
en.a:
Companies are not always buying software. Some want an enduring capability they own. Others need evidence that an uncertain use case is worth pursuing. Others simply need work delivered without operating a system themselves.

We discuss goals, current workflows, data and frequency of use before choosing an engagement. Technical feasibility matters, but it is not the business case. A possible implementation can still be premature if usage is low or source preparation costs too much.

en.q: When does a full custom build make sense?
en.a:
A clear goal, frequent use and an accountable business owner are good signals. The team needs a repeatable way of working, with its data, rules and feedback embedded in a system it owns.

A full build covers discovery, product design, model integration, workflow engineering, launch and maintenance. A typical first release takes 6–12 weeks, depending on scope. Acceptance criteria, data access, system boundaries and ongoing responsibilities should be agreed before work begins.

en.q: What should a pilot actually prove?
en.a:
A pilot should answer a commercial question: does automating this workflow create value, does it work with real source material, and will people use it? It should not merely make a demonstration more polished or squeeze a full program into a smaller budget.

We select a bounded use case and deliver a first working version in 2–6 weeks. Inputs, success measures and stop conditions are defined up front. Results determine whether to expand, revise or stop. The purpose is a sound decision, not a predetermined commitment to build more.

en.q: Who should consider a managed AI service?
en.a:
Managed service fits teams that value reliable output without hiring engineers, maintaining workflows or following every model change. The client provides work, source material and quality criteria; Cyano delivers results through AI workflows with human review.

First results are typically delivered within two weeks, followed by monthly or batch work. The output agreement matters: what a batch includes, how it is accepted, how revisions work, when more client information is needed and how additional scope is priced.

en.q: How should a company assess the return?
en.a:
Measure the current process end to end. Collection, coordination, review, rework and waiting can matter as much as drafting. Check whether saved time can actually be redeployed and whether faster delivery changes a business outcome.

Then include implementation and ongoing costs: data preparation, integration, model usage, review and maintenance. Uncertain benefits should remain hypotheses to test. Another client’s highest return is not a forecast for your workflow.

en.q: What should we bring to the first conversation?
en.a:
You do not need a technical requirements document. Bring a real work sample, the current process, common problems and an acceptable output. Volumes, costs and review feedback help clarify value.

Include someone who can make business decisions and someone who understands data and permissions. Many delivery bottlenecks are about ownership: who confirms a rule, supplies a source or accepts a result? Diagnosis makes those responsibilities explicit.

en.q: Who maintains the work after launch?
en.a:
A full build includes basic maintenance, with continuing iteration available. Maintenance is part of an ongoing pilot service. In a managed engagement, Cyano operates the workflow and delivers the results. The client still supplies business changes and feedback.

Maintenance includes source updates, permission changes, model evolution and new requirements, not just bug fixes. A clear feedback path and a shared approach to scope changes keep the relationship practical.

en.q: What if the pilot does not meet expectations?
en.a:
First identify the cause: the wrong problem, inadequate sources, poor workflow design or unrealistic expectations. Each calls for a different response. Missing knowledge requires better sources; weak commercial value may be a reason to stop.

Agree acceptance criteria and decision points before building. A 30–45 minute conversation introduces the use case; a diagnosis within a week provides a recommendation. You decide whether to proceed once scope, investment and uncertainty are clear.
